scope: Four nonvacuous conditional UNSAT counterexample checks and two SAT boundary models. Not Kotlin, persistence, Office or full-system proof.

positive.name: admitted undoable transition has representable immediate undo
positive.hypotheses: Exact +1 commit and +1 undo, exact before/after data binding, archive counts unchanged by serialization. Does not verify code, IO or concurrency.
positive.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun revision () Int)
(declare-fun archived_before () Int)
(declare-fun archived_after () Int)
(assert
 (>= revision 0))
(assert
 (>= archived_before 0))
(assert
 (<= archived_before 128))
(assert
 (>= archived_after 0))
(assert
 (<= archived_after 128))
(assert
 (let ((?x15 (+ revision archived_before)))
 (<= ?x15 9223372036854775807)))
(assert
 (<= (+ (+ revision 1) archived_after) 9223372036854775807))
(assert
 (let ((?x23 (+ revision 2)))
 (let ((?x24 (+ ?x23 archived_before)))
 (<= ?x24 9223372036854775807))))
(assert
 (or (> (+ revision 2) 9223372036854775807) (> (+ (+ revision 2) archived_before) 9223372036854775807) (<= (+ revision 2) (+ revision 1))))
(check-sat)

positive.name: serialized successful transition invalidates an old expected revision
positive.hypotheses: First publication completes r+1 under the same process lock before second comparison; no rollback/external writer. Content equality is separately tested.
positive.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun revision () Int)
(declare-fun expected () Int)
(assert
 (>= revision 0))
(assert
 (< revision 9223372036854775807))
(assert
 (= expected revision))
(assert
 (let ((?x19 (+ revision 1)))
(= expected ?x19)))
(check-sat)

positive.name: bounded stream consumes at most limit plus one
positive.hypotheses: InputStream obeys requested read length; each non-EOF read returns. Zero progress is refused. No wall-clock bound or guarantee a provider returns.
positive.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun limit () Int)
(declare-fun consumed () Int)
(declare-fun read_count () Int)
(assert
 (>= limit 1))
(assert
 (<= limit 524288))
(assert
 (>= consumed 0))
(assert
 (<= consumed limit))
(assert
 (>= read_count 1))
(assert
 (<= read_count 8192))
(assert
 (<= read_count (+ (- limit consumed) 1)))
(assert
 (> (+ consumed read_count) (+ limit 1)))
(check-sat)

positive.name: append-only admitted merge keeps archive count within total capacity
positive.hypotheses: Unique IDs, identical IDs not added, conflicts refused; the model assumes the implementation computes these counts correctly.
positive.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun old_count () Int)
(declare-fun added_count () Int)
(declare-fun old_archived () Int)
(declare-fun added_archived () Int)
(assert
 (>= old_count 0))
(assert
 (>= added_count 0))
(assert
 (let ((?x124 (+ old_count added_count)))
 (<= ?x124 128)))
(assert
 (>= old_archived 0))
(assert
 (<= old_archived old_count))
(assert
 (>= added_archived 0))
(assert
 (<= added_archived added_count))
(assert
 (or (> (+ old_archived added_archived) 128) (> (+ old_archived added_archived) (+ old_count added_count))))
(check-sat)

(declare-fun archived_after () Int)
(assert

(assert
 (= archived_before 1))
(assert
 (= archived_after 0))
(assert

 (<= ?x15 9223372036854775807)))

negative.scope: Restore at the old reserved boundary remains available through the old API, but cannot promise an additional revision-consuming undo.

negative.name: per-sheet cell bounds do not imply a workbook cell bound
negative.smt2:
; benchmark generated from python API
(set-info :status unknown)
(declare-fun old_count () Int)
(declare-fun added_count () Int)
(assert
 (= old_count 15000))
(assert
 (= added_count 15000))
(assert
 (<= old_count 20000))
(assert
 (<= added_count 20000))
(assert
 (let ((?x124 (+ old_count added_count)))
(> ?x124 20000)))
(check-sat)
negative.scope: Two independently valid sheet counts violate the aggregate workbook cap; new implementation checks the sum before copying.
